title: How long a tool call has run (user 2026-11-19, on a backgrounded "Ran glaeda-gh wait …" row: "would be useful to see how long it has been running for"). The fake agent's elapsed-tour runs a shell that finishes, a shell that goes on in the background, then a shell held running in the foreground; after a minute the running rows count their time at the row's edge, and the finished row's opened Shell card says how long it took. Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/tool-call-elapsed.json --mac
